name: lin_idempotent_join
statement: (n : ℕ) (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A * A = A) (hB : B * B = B) (hAB : A * B = B * A) : (A + B - A * B) * (A + B - A * B) = A + B - A * B
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A * A = A) (hB : B * B = B) (hAB : A * B = B * A), (A + B - A * B) * (A + B - A * B) = A + B - A * B
informal: For commuting idempotent matrices A, B the join A + B − AB is idempotent — it equals I − (I − A)(I − B), a product of commuting idempotents; or expand and rewrite with the three hypotheses.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ), A * A = A → B * B = B → A * B = B * A → (A + B - A * B) * (A + B - A * B) = A + B - A * B
